items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But we stayed here quite a while, at the Kelly's Stables there.

ctx.x: But we stayed here quite a while, at the Kelly's Stables there. This is when all the pimps and all the hustlers would hang out there. You'd see all the prostitutes. They would bring -- the madams would bring all the girls in and set them around the table. And I could tell you some stories about Jackie Gill, our old favorite. You remember Jackie Gill? This is when I met Jackie Gill. He was one of the boys.
But any way, this was Kelly's Stables then, and Leonard was coming around then and Georgia All, so now here we go. Benny Goodman had Charlie with him at this time. This

is my reason for telling you this now. Benny was auditioning another band, and Georgie All had been coming around with -- playing with us, jamming with us all the time at Kelly's Tables. And he was -- Benny was looking for a rhythm guitarist. I had a friend then who was in New York, a white guy by the name of Mike Bryan. He was from Memphis. A very good guitarist. And I recommended Mike for the job. I was working with Roy, I was having such a ball I really wasn't interested.
